rewrites.yea_description: Voted for H.R. 4, the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, which restored federal approval of voting changes in places with a record of discrimination. The House passed it 219-212.
rewrites.nay_description: Voted against H.R. 4, the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, which restored federal approval of voting changes in places with a record of discrimination. The House passed it 219-212.
